property.name: cardTitle
property.label: Card Title
property.description: Title displayed on the component card

property.name: iconName
property.label: Icon Name
property.description: SLDS icon name (e.g., standard:account)

property.name: childObjectApiName
property.label: Child Object API Name
property.description: API name of the related child object

property.name: relationshipFieldApiName
property.label: Relationship Field API Name
property.description: Lookup/Master-Detail field on child object pointing to parent

property.name: fieldApiNames
property.label: Field API Names (comma-separated)
property.description: Comma-separated list of field API names to display as columns

property.name: sortField
property.label: Default Sort Field
property.description: API name of the field to sort by

property.name: sortDirection
property.label: Sort Direction
property.description: ASC or DESC

property.name: recordLimit
property.label: Max Records
property.description: Maximum number of records to display

property.name: rowActions
property.label: Row Actions (JSON)
property.description: JSON array of row actions. Example: [{"label":"View Invoice","name":"My_Object__c.View_Invoice","type":"quick_action"},{"label":"View Record","name":"view_record"}]

property.name: showNewButton
property.label: Show New Button
property.description: Adds a New button to the card header that creates a child record with the parent lookup pre-filled.

property.name: hideRecordLink
property.label: Hide Record Link (First Column)
property.description: When enabled, the first column link is hidden and users cannot navigate to the related record.
